slides.title: Growth is on plan; SMB retention needs a fix
points: Revenue grew 41% year over year to $48M, two points ahead of plan.
Enterprise now drives 55% of new bookings, up from 38% a year ago.
SMB churn rose to 3.1% monthly and is the main risk to FY27.
slides.takeaway: Approve the $2.4M retention programme to protect the growth plan.
